tasks.corrected_reference_answer: get_type_id applies next to the returnTypeId before passing the result to inner (sphinx/domains/cpp/_ast.py:3237-3241). In int (*func)(int,int), inner is *func and next is the following parameter suffix (int,int). Building the function type first and then its inner pointer structure preserves pointer-to-function grouping; the reference reverses these roles.

tasks.corrected_reference_answer: ASTParenExpr.__eq__ returns NotImplemented for incompatible types and compares expressions otherwise (sphinx/domains/cpp/_ast.py:663-666). This leaves Python an opportunity to try the other operand's equality implementation instead of asserting inequality immediately. If neither handles equality, default equality behavior applies; == does not fall back to __ne__. Cooperative comparison does not guarantee symmetry for arbitrary classes.
